claim.claim-text: 5. The acceleration transducer according to claim 1, wherein the first piezoelectric element has a high sensitivity for a shear force along the longitudinal axis being the principal tangential axis, a low sensitivity for a shear force along the vertical axis being the secondary tangential axis and a low sensitivity for a normal force along the transverse axis being the normal axis; or wherein the first piezoelectric element has a high sensitivity for a shear force along the longitudinal axis being the normal axis, a low sensitivity for a shear force along the vertical axis being the secondary tangential axis and a low sensitivity for a shear force along the transverse axis being the principal tangential axis; or wherein the first piezoelectric element has a high sensitivity for a shear force along the vertical axis being the principal tangential axis, a low sensitivity for a shear force along the longitudinal axis being the secondary tangential axis and a low sensitivity for a normal force along the transverse axis being the normal axis.

6. The acceleration transducer according to claim 1, wherein the first piezoelectric element is configured with a high sensitivity for a shear force along a principal tangential axis and a low sensitivity for a shear force along a secondary tangential axis or a normal axis; and wherein the first piezoelectric element is configured so that a high sensitivity for a shear force generates at least by a factor of 5 times more piezoelectric charges per unit force than a low sensitivity for a shear force.

7. The acceleration transducer according to claim 1, wherein the first electrically conductive end face coating and the first electrically conductive lateral surface coating form a first continuous electrically conductive coating; and wherein the piezoelectric interference charges picked off for the shear force along the secondary tangential axis have a polarity opposite to that of the piezoelectric interference charges picked off for the normal force along the normal axis.

8. The acceleration transducer according to claim 7, wherein a size of the first electrically conductive lateral surface coating of the first piezoelectric element is configured in such a way that the first continuous electrically conductive coating picks off essentially the same number of piezoelectric interference charges for the shear force acting along the secondary tangential axis and for the normal force acting along the normal axis.

9. The acceleration transducer according to claim 7, wherein the first lateral face includes a first portion that is disposed normal to the tangential axis of the first piezoelectric element; wherein the first lateral surface includes a first further electrically conductive lateral surface coating; wherein a ratio of a size of the first electrically conductive lateral surface coating and a size of the first further electrically conductive lateral surface coating is configured in such a way that the continuous electrically conductive coating picks off essentially the same number of piezoelectric interference charges for the shear force acting along the secondary tangential axis and for the normal force acting along the normal axis.

10. The acceleration transducer according to claim 9, further comprising a first piezoelectric element conductor and a second piezoelectric element conductor; wherein the first electrically conductive lateral surface coating is materially bonded to the first piezoelectric element conductor; wherein the further first further electrically conductive lateral surface coating is materially bonded to the second piezoelectric element conductor; wherein the first piezoelectric element conductor is configured to transmit piezoelectric charges as a plurality of first acceleration signals from the first continuous electrically conductive coating; and wherein the second piezoelectric element conductor is configured to transmit piezoelectric charges as a plurality of second acceleration signals from the second continuous electrically conductive coating.

11. The acceleration transducer according to claim 10, wherein the first electrically conductive end face coating is material bonded to the first end face and configured to seal microscopic pores in the first end face; wherein the first electrically conductive lateral surface coating is material bonded to the first lateral surface and configured to seal microscopic pores in the first lateral surface; and wherein that as a result of the sealing of the microscopic pores eliminates the need to the mechanically pre-load the first piezoelectric element.

12. The acceleration transducer according to claim 1, wherein each of the first end face and second end faces is disposed in a manner opposite to the normal axis of the first piezoelectric element; wherein the first lateral surface is disposed normal to the secondary tangential axis of the first piezoelectric element; wherein the first lateral surface includes a first further electrically conductive lateral surface coating; wherein the first electrically conductive end face coating and the first electrically conductive lateral surface coating form a first continuous electrically conductive coating; and wherein the second electrically conductive end face coating and the first further electrically conductive lateral surface coating form a second continuous electrically conductive coating.

13. The acceleration transducer according to claim 2, wherein the second piezoelectric element has a high sensitivity for a shear force along the longitudinal axis being the principal tangential axis, a low sensitivity for a shear force along the vertical axis being the secondary tangential axis and a low sensitivity for a normal force along the transverse axis being the normal axis; or wherein the second piezoelectric element has a high sensitivity for a shear force along the longitudinal axis being the normal axis, a low sensitivity for a shear force along the vertical axis being the secondary tangential axis and a low sensitivity for a shear force along the transverse axis being the principal tangential axis; or wherein the second piezoelectric element has a high sensitivity for a shear force along the vertical axis being the principal tangential axis, a low sensitivity for a shear force along the longitudinal axis being the secondary tangential axis and a low sensitivity for a normal force along the transverse axis being the normal axis.

14. The acceleration transducer according to claim 3, wherein the third piezoelectric element has a high sensitivity for a shear force along the longitudinal axis being the principal tangential axis, a low sensitivity for a shear force along the vertical axis being the secondary tangential axis and a low sensitivity for a normal force along the transverse axis being the normal axis; or wherein the third piezoelectric element has a high sensitivity for a shear force along the longitudinal axis being the normal axis, a low sensitivity for a shear force along the vertical axis being the secondary tangential axis and a low sensitivity for a shear force along the transverse axis being the principal tangential axis; or wherein the third piezoelectric element has a high sensitivity for a shear force along the vertical axis being the principal tangential axis, a low sensitivity for a shear force along the longitudinal axis being the secondary tangential axis and a low sensitivity for a normal force along the transverse axis being the normal axis.

15. The acceleration transducer according to claim 12, wherein the second and third lateral surfaces is disposed normal to the principal tangential axis of the first piezoelectric element; wherein the second lateral surface includes a second electrically conductive lateral surface coating; wherein the third lateral surface includes a third electrically conductive lateral surface coating; and wherein the second and third electrically conductive lateral surface coatings are part of the first continuous electrically conductive coating or part of the second continuous electrically conductive coating.

16. The acceleration transducer according to claim 15, wherein the fourth lateral surface is disposed normal to the secondary tangential axis of the first piezoelectric element and includes a fourth electrically conductive lateral surface coating; and wherein the second and fourth electrically conductive lateral surface coatings are part of the first continuous electrically conductive coating or part of the second continuous electrically conductive coating.

17. The acceleration transducer according to claim 12, wherein the second and third lateral surfaces is disposed normal to the principal tangential axis of the first piezoelectric element; wherein the second lateral surface includes a second electrically conductive lateral surface coating; wherein the third lateral surface includes a third electrically conductive lateral surface coating; and wherein the third electrically conductive lateral surface coating is part of the first continuous electrically conductive coating and the second electrically conductive lateral surface coating is part of the second continuous electrically conductive coating.

18. The acceleration transducer according to claim 17, wherein the fourth lateral surface of the first piezoelectric element is disposed normal to the secondary tangential axis of the first piezoelectric element; wherein the fourth lateral surface includes a fourth electrically conductive lateral surface coating; wherein the third electrically conductive lateral surface coating is part of the first continuous electrically conductive coating, and wherein the fourth electrically conductive lateral surface coating is part of the second continuous electrically conductive coating.
